sources_checked: WebSearch corroboration of DCCEEW viewer decommission / CSIRO Data Access Portal
WebSearch + WebFetch corroboration of Visit NSW Pub With No Beer listing
notes: Case ingestion run. Operator supplied fourteen docx documents (in two batches) forming a complete prior six-stage investigation conducted 2026-06-16/17 under an earlier, self-authored framework. This run: (1) parsed the 76-entry Evidence Register programmatically into this repository's schema, deduplicating to 26 sources, (2) independently checked all 13 mechanism claims in the Mechanism Register against this repository's actual 68-mechanism catalogue - all confirmed correct, (3) found and logged two real internal inconsistencies in the source material's own frozen documents rather than resolving them by assumption - an unverified 'Tier Infinity Audit' external citation (CTR-0001) and a mechanism-count discrepancy between the Lattice Atlas and Mechanism Register (CTR-0002), (4) attempted a direct WebFetch re-verification of the single most load-bearing external page (dcceew.gov.au flying-fox-monitoring), which timed out, and fell back to WebSearch corroboration - upgraded EV-0038 and EV-0039 to Verified on that weaker basis, (5) independently confirmed the Visit NSW Pub With No Beer listing referenced in the Supplementary Tourism Pathway document, (6) noted that the original .docx files were no longer accessible by build time and substituted this repository's own extracted plaintext for preserved/ (DEC-0003). Every other item carries this repository's own 'Requires Verification'/'Unverified' status per DEC-0001.
